fields.title: Limits of dense graph sequences
fields.journal: Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series B
fields.author: László Lovász and Balázs Szegedy
fields.keywords: Graph homomorphism, Convergent graph sequence, Limit, Quasirandom graph
fields.abstract: We show that if a sequence of dense graphs Gn has the property that for every fixed graph F, the density of copies of F in Gn tends to a limit, then there is a natural "limit object," namely a symmetric measurable function W:[0,1]2→[0,1]. This limit object determines all the limits of subgraph densities. Conversely, every such function arises as a limit object. We also characterize graph parameters that are obtained as limits of subgraph densities by the "reflection positivity" property. Along the way we introduce a rather general model of random graphs, which seems to be interesting on its own right.
